'''West-4''' was the [[Callsign|call sign]] of a [[human]] individual who served in the [[Consolidated Holdings of Preox-Morlana Corporation|Preox-Morlana]] [[Corporate Tactical Forces]]. During the [[Imperial Era]], West-4 participated in an [[ambush on Ferrix]] against [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor]]. While en route to [[Ferrix]] aboard a [[BTY-180 carrier]], [[Linus Mosk]] handed West-4 the [[holopuck]] of Andor during the mission briefing.<ref name="Episode 2" /> [[West-3]] and West-4 were left in [[Maarva Carassi Andor|Maarva Andor]]'s residence while the rest of the team moved on to assist [[East Team]] in apprehending Cassian.<ref name="Episode 3" />
